tenders.title: Procurement Of Advanced Diagnostic Tool For Predictive Maintenance Of Various Transmission Lines
tenders.scope_summary: Tender for the procurement of an advanced diagnostic tool for predictive maintenance of transmission lines under Kumaon Zone, Haldwani and Garhwal Zone, Roorkee. The system is expected to provide real-time equipment health monitoring, alerts, analytics, and support predictive maintenance with requisite IT/OT cybersecurity.
key_points: For predictive maintenance of transmission lines.
Includes real-time equipment health monitoring, alerts, and analytics.
Location: Kumaon Zone, Haldwani and Garhwal Zone, Roorkee.

tenders.title: Implementation Of Ai-Based Predictive Maintenance And Asset Management Solution For Stage-1 Tdbfp Auxiliary Oil Pumps
tenders.scope_summary: Corrigendum to a tender for the implementation of an AI-based predictive maintenance and asset management solution for Stage-1 TDBFP Auxiliary Oil Pumps.
key_points: Implementation of AI-based predictive maintenance solution.
Specific to Stage-1 TDBFP Auxiliary Oil Pumps.

tenders.title: Facility Management Services - Lumpsum Based - Asset Management Contract For Powergrid, M P Hall And E- Tower Guest House At Sector -43, Gurugram, Haryana
tenders.scope_summary: Bids are invited for facility management services on a lumpsum basis, specifically an asset management contract for Powergrid, M P Hall and E-Tower Guest House at Sector-43, Gurugram, Haryana. The scope of work includes consumables to be provided by the service provider.
key_points: Facility management services on a lumpsum basis.
Asset management contract for Powergrid, M P Hall and E-Tower Guest House.
Consumables to be provided by the service provider.
